name: Custom Chimney Shrouds
description: Chimney Shrouds, also called chimney caps, chimney pots, chimney covers, can be used as a decorative or functional top for a chimney. Not only do these caps serve the purpose of protecting the top of a chimney, it also can add a beautiful aesthetic to a home’s roof line. All Salvo Metal Works chimney shrouds are made to order by our in-house fabricators. Expertly crafted from high-quality materials, these products are designed to shield your chimney from the elements while adding a refined aesthetic touch. Whether you’re looking to prevent water infiltration, block debris, or improve draft performance, our custom solutions provide both functionality and style. With various designs and finishes available, each piece is tailored to complement your architectural vision and ensure long-lasting durability. Over time, the copper naturally develops a beautiful patina, adding a timeless, rustic charm to your home’s roofline while maintaining its structural integrity.
